reels.title: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses 'Memory Modality Selection,' which is highly relatable to human cognitive science. Given the 1.05x audience velocity multiplier, it provides a perfect bridge between academic research and the day-to-day frustration of users interacting with 'forgetful' AI agents.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do your AI agents have such a short memory—and how can they learn to prioritize what's actually important?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A student highlighting only the crucial sentences in a textbook versus trying to memorize every single word on the page.
